title: Sensory Precision Inference for Multimodal Arbitration under Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.15065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents operating on multisensory data cannot assume that all sensory modalities remain consistently informative. In real environments, sensory streams are frequently corrupted by noise, missing data, or inter-modal incongruence, requiring adaptive arbitration between competing sensory hypotheses. While active inference provides a principled framework for uncertainty-guided inference, the role of dynamically inferred sensory precision in generative multimodal arbitration under sensory conflict remains comparatively underexplored. We propose a multimodal perceptual inference model in which latent beliefs and modality-specific sensory precisions are jointly updated through iterative free-energy minimization. In our proposed model, sensory precision dynamics not only reflect sensory uncertainty but actively shape the evolution of latent beliefs during multimodal conflict. translated_title: 不确定性下多模态仲裁的感觉精度推断
translated_abstract: 基于多感觉数据运行的自主智能体不能假设所有感觉模态始终保持一致的信息性。在真实环境中，感觉流经常受到噪声、数据缺失或模态间不一致性的破坏，这需要在相互竞争的感觉假设之间进行自适应仲裁。虽然主动推断为不确定性引导的推断提供了一个原则性框架，但在感觉冲突下，动态推断的感觉精度在生成式多模态仲裁中的作用仍然相对未被充分探索。我们提出了一个多模态感知推断模型，其中潜在信念和模态特定的感觉精度通过迭代自由能最小化进行联合更新。在我们提出的模型中，感觉精度动态不仅反映感觉不确定性，而且在多模态冲突期间主动塑造潜在信念的演变。此外，我们还引入了一个关于感觉精度的学习先验
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多模态感知推断模型，通过迭代自由能最小化联合更新潜在信念与模态特定感觉精度，使感觉精度动态在感觉冲突中主动塑造信念演变，从而实现不确定性环境下的自适应多模态仲裁。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal perceptual inference model that jointly updates latent beliefs and modality-specific sensory precisions through iterative free-energy minimization, enabling adaptive multimodal arbitration under uncertainty where sensory precision dynamics actively shape belief evolution during sensory conflict.
